title: TypeFactory: streaming-aware discriminated union emitters + lightweight Zod/JSON-Schema shim
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a streaming-aware TypeFactory that emits stable discriminated-union runtime hints plus a small, permissive Zod/JSON-Schema shim to validate partial and retried streaming outputs. Motivation: many LLM outputs arrive incrementally (streaming tokens) and our current Zod adapters assume full-message schemas which causes brittle failures during retries, early aborts, and progressive parses. This ticket designs and implements: 1) A TypeFactory emitter that annotates discriminators with streaming boundaries and recovery hints ("stamp IDs") so the client can resume parsing across retries without rehydrating the entire stream. 2) A lightweight Zod shim that:   - accepts incremental chunks and merges into a syntactic tree,   - tolerates missing optional branches during partial parse,   - exposes a deterministic finalize() call that enforces full-schema constraints once the stream completes. 3) JSON-Schema emitter parity for downstream tools that rely on schema.json. 4) Examples + migration guide for existing SDK consumers to opt-in with minimal changes. Key trade-offs considered: - Strict early validation reduces downstream errors but makes retries brittle. We choose permissive incremental validation + strict finalize to balance developer ergonomics and safety. - Adding stamps increases token metadata slightly; we keep stamp footprint minimal and configurable.
updates: 2026-02-25: Initial spike — prototyped a streaming stamp concept. Verified we can attach a 12-byte stable stamp per discriminated branch that survives retries.
2026-03-01: Design review with PM and DX. Decided on two-stage validation model (incremental permissive + final strict). PM requested that finalize() expose conflict diagnostics for rollouts.

2026-03-04: Implemented TypeFactory emitter v0.1 — emits discriminators as {"_kind": "OrderCreated", "_stamp": "s-abc123", ...} when streaming flag enabled. Unit tests added for single-branch streaming and nested unions.

2026-03-07: Engineering review: suggested API tweaks: TypeFactory.emit({ streaming: true, stampSize: 12 }) and SDK parser expose parseStream(stream, opts) -> ProgressiveParseHandle. Added backpressure note for Node streams.
2026-03-10: Working on Zod shim finalize() path and JSON-Schema roundtrip. Need to coordinate with runtime team for kernel-level retry idempotency headers (ENG-240712 flagged).
notes_for_engineers: Implementation notes: 1) Parser must expose resume(stamp) that replays cached prefix from SDK's KV cache to reconstruct context. 2) For TypeScript runtime we should prioritize zero-copy merging of token buffers. 3) Provide example: parseStream(tokenAsyncIterator, { permissive: true }).progress(callback).finalize(). 4) Keep stamps opt-in via client config to avoid increasing token usage for all users.
acceptance_criteria: TypeFactory can emit discriminated unions with streaming stamps and optional stampSize config.
SDK parser supports incremental parsing and exposes finalize() that validates full schema using Zod shim.
JSON-Schema emitter produces schema equivalence within 1:1 mapping for discriminators when not streaming.
Integration tests for retries where stream aborts and resume(stamp) leads to identical final hydrated object.
Docs and two migration examples (one small app, one enterprise rollout guide) added to repo/examples.
review_feedback: PM (Jules Han): favor finalize diagnostics to surface regression tests for rollouts.
Design (Rina Sato): UI should not show stamps to end-users; stamps are purely SDK/runtime metadata.
Runtime (Kai Müller): coordinate kernel headers for idempotent retry (we may add X-RW-STREAM-STAMP).
